items.claim: Abdul Hussein is much younger than Cody Gibson and had a full training camp to prepare for the fight.
items.quote: he's obviously a lot younger than Cody Gibson. He has a lot of things going his way. He's at a full time to prepare for this.

items.claim: Cody Gibson is pushing 40 years old and is taking this fight on two weeks' notice with cross-country travel.
items.quote: Cody Gibson pushing 40 years old, flying across the country on two weeks notice.

items.claim: Cody Gibson has shown a noticeable decline in overall durability, specifically regarding his submission defense, cardio, and chin.
items.quote: He's been really he's had a real drop in his overall durability in terms of his submission defense, the cardio, the chin.
